causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Actual demand was lower than that which had been forecast by AEMO.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Plant failures on 14 January at AGL's Torrens Island B unit 3 (200 MW) in South Australia, Loy Yang A unit 3 (around 560 MW) in Victoria, and cooling limitations at Loy Yang B reduced the capacity of the B1 and B2 units by 99 MW.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The capacity of Loy Yang A1 and A4 was also affected by the ambient temperature conditions, leading to a reduction of 120 MW.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 3.21 pm GDF Suez rebid 110 MW of capacity at Loy Yang B from low prices to high prices and at 3.24 pm Snowy Hydro rebid 152 MW of capacity at Laverton North from low prices to high prices.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: imports into Victoria from Tasmania across the Basslink interconnector reduced by around 70 MW

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Capacity priced at $12 000/MWh at Loy Yang B was dispatched, but because it was ramp rate limited it did not set the price.
